source_text: Mulier quae conceperit et pepererit masculum immunda septem diebus. Nativitas carnis purificatione indiget. Masculus — sensus fortior.
pass_a_gloss: Woman who will-have-conceived and will-have-borne male unclean seven days. Birth of-flesh purification needs. Male — sense stronger.
pass_b_english: A woman who [[conceives and bears a male is unclean seven days >> Bible:Leviticus 12:2]]. Fleshly birth needs purification. “Male” names the stronger sense.
